newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson new data, voice services product.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson new data, voice services product.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Monday it would launch a new communications solution, Multi-purpose Exchange, which allows both data and voice services to be carried across the same leased lines.
"The solution is primarily aimed at organisations using leased lines to link different sites, enabling them to make the most of the capacity available in these lines," Ericsson said in a statement.
Data and voice services share the same bandwidth provided by one or more 64 kbps leased lines.
Voice services are compressed to a quarter of their size, thereby increasing the capacity of the lines. Data services can be delivered at up to 2 Mbps, Ericsson said.
The solution will be shown live for the first time at the exhibition CeBIT '97 in Hanover, Germany, on March 13-19.
